title: Four settled-or-dead attempts of epic-9pd leave standing worktrees in the operator's repo
body: A live smoke test of the new status census found worktrees of tick 19l attempts 18-19, tick cwa attempt 7 and tick h0f attempt 14 still registered under .herdr/worktrees, hours to days old — the shape of runs whose teardown never ran (the killed-writer pattern the learnings already record). They are honest input to the new gap surface but accumulate, and a stale-worktree settlement from durable evidence (is the attempt collected? is the branch merged?) would keep the census meaning what it says.
